name: rakitek
description: Multi-style UI/UX Registry, Next.js Visual Showcase, MCP Server, and Antigravity Skills

scripts.dev: npm run sync && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run sync && npm run lint && npm run build -w packages/mcp && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run sync && npm run lint && tsx scripts/test-lint-rules.ts && npm run test -w packages/mcp
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run fidelity:all && npm run build -w packages/mcp && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/mcp && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
